compute_generation_metrics: compute generation metrics for predicted crystals against ground truth and save results to a metrics file
GenEval_get_metrics: get all generation evaluation metrics including validity, density wasserstein distance, and coverage for predicted crystals
GenEval_get_validity: get validity statistics including composition validity, structural validity, and overall validity of generated crystals
GenEval_get_density_wdist: compute the wasserstein distance between predicted and ground truth crystal density distributions
GenEval_get_coverage: compute coverage metrics comparing generated crystals to ground truth using structure and composition cutoffs
